_comment: Analysis categories for the price-position comparison (ADR-006).
Price-INDEPENDENT by construction: the only inputs are the product title, the URL path and the
shop's own section slugs. Price, old price, sale state and currency are never read.
Deliberately NOT used as signals, because they describe price or an occasion rather than a product
type: nedorogie-czvety / nedorogie (price band), aktsii-* / topsale / sale (promotions),
8-marta / 14-fevralya / novyj-god (occasions). A listing that carries only such slugs falls through
to the title rules, and is counted as unclassified if the title says nothing either.
Matching: titles and URL paths are lower-cased, punctuation becomes spaces, and a keyword matches
only as a whole word or whole phrase. Section slugs must match exactly.
First matching rule wins; exclusions are tried before sections.
This file is versioned and tagged before any analysis run; changes get a new rules_version.

categories.roses_mono: Roses and mono-bouquets (one named flower type)
categories.mixed_bouquets: Mixed bouquets (two or more named flower types)
categories.bouquets_unspecified: Bouquets whose composition is not stated in the listing or post
categories.edible_sets: Edible and berry sets (strawberries in chocolate, sweets, fruit)
categories.out_of_scope: Explicitly excluded: not a flower, plant or edible product
categories.unclassified: No rule matched; excluded from analysis and reported as a count

exclusions.reason: add-ons sold beside a bouquet (vases, toys, cakes, cards, candles)

sections.reason: the shop publishes the listing in a box/basket section, or the title says box or basket
plant section, or the title names a houseplant or says in a pot
edible/berry section, or the title names berries, chocolate, sweets or fruit
the shop publishes the listing in a single-flower-type section
bouquet or arrangement section; the split below decides mono vs mixed
no section matched, but the title names at least one flower type

_comment: Applied to rules whose category is 'bouquets_split'. Counts the distinct flower types named in
the title using flower_lexicon: exactly one type -> roses_mono (a mono-bouquet of that type);
two or more -> mixed_bouquets; none named -> bouquets_unspecified (the composition is unknown
and is never guessed). Secret's Telegram captions and several competitors' poetic product names
give no flower type, so bouquets_unspecified is expected to be large; under the count-only merge
rule the three bouquet categories merge into one before any price is looked at.
